question: Where is the goddess established and what does she unify?
premises: The goddess unifies the great root spike into a single emissive abode.
She rests in the heart of Bhairavī.
Bhairavī is characterized as nourishing all beings.
inference: The goddess is the unified emissive ground of the root power, established in Bhairavī's heart as the nourisher of all beings.
uncertainties: The technical referent of mahāmūlaśūla may depend on the surrounding tantric context.
plain_english: She makes the great root spike into one emissive abode and rests in the heart of Bhairavī, who nourishes all beings.
